joint-079.en: A robotic arm removes a white plate from a dish rack and sets it flat on the table. It then picks up a red pomegranate and places it gently onto the center of the white plate.
joint-079.zh: 机械臂从碗碟架上取下一个白色盘子，将其平放在桌上，随后拿起一个红色石榴，轻轻放到白盘中央。

joint-043.en: A dual-arm robot sits at a wooden table with a glass jug and brown cup. The left arm grasps the jug handle, tilts it to pour liquid into the cup, then places it back down smoothly.
joint-043.zh: 双臂机器人位于一张木桌前，桌上放着玻璃水壶和棕色杯子。左臂握住水壶把手，倾斜水壶，将液体倒入杯中，然后平稳地放下水壶。

joint-014.en: The robot arm opens the rice cooker's lid, presses its off-white button, and closes the lid—executing a precise shutdown sequence on the white appliance with orange handle. The motion is smooth and focused, occurring on a tiled workbench marked with blue grid lines.
joint-014.zh: 机械臂打开电饭煲盖子，按下米白色按钮，再合上盖子，准确完成这台带橙色把手的白色电饭煲的关机操作。整个动作平稳，操作集中在设备上；工作台铺有瓷砖，并标有蓝色网格线。

joint-032.en: A dual-arm robot inserts a red RAM module into a motherboard on a white table. The left arm grasps and aligns the module while the right arm assists in seating it securely.
joint-032.zh: 双臂机器人将一根红色内存条插入白色桌面上的主板。左臂抓住内存条并对准插槽，右臂辅助将其安装到位。

joint-037.en: A dual-arm robot sits at a kitchen counter with a black microwave and various items nearby. The left arm picks up a brown cloth, wipes the top of the microwave, then places the cloth back on the counter.
joint-037.zh: 双臂机器人位于厨房台面前，旁边有一台黑色微波炉和其他物品。左臂拿起棕色抹布，擦拭微波炉顶部，然后将抹布放回台面。

joint-066.en: A robotic arm retrieves two slices of toasted bread from a white toaster on a tiled kitchen counter. It places each slice sequentially onto a blue oval plate positioned to the left of the appliance.
joint-066.zh: 机械臂从瓷砖厨房台面上的白色烤面包机中取出两片烤好的面包，依次放到烤面包机左侧的蓝色椭圆形盘子上。

joint-057.en: A dual-arm robot holds a brass gong steady with its left gripper while repeatedly striking it with a red-tasseled mallet in its right gripper. The motion is precise and rhythmic against an indoor exhibition backdrop.
joint-057.zh: 双臂机器人用左侧夹爪稳稳握住一面黄铜锣，右侧夹爪持带红穗的槌子反复敲击。动作准确且富有节奏，背景为室内展览场景。

joint-064.en: A dual-arm robot stands before a stocked snack shelf with a wire cart below. The right arm reaches out, grasps a white Pom's Life bag, and deposits it into the cart while the left arm stays still.
joint-064.zh: 双臂机器人站在摆满零食的货架前，下方有一辆金属网格推车。右臂伸出，抓起一袋白色包装的 Pom's Life 商品，放入推车；左臂保持不动。

joint-073.en: A dual-arm robot uses its right arm to pick up a green eraser from a table stand. It wipes blue writing off a whiteboard with smooth sweeping motions, then returns the eraser to its original spot.
joint-073.zh: 双臂机器人用右臂从桌面支架上拿起绿色板擦，以平稳的擦拭动作擦去白板上的蓝色字迹，然后将板擦放回原处。

newview-004.zh: 打开笔记本电脑的上盖。

newview-048.en: A dual-arm robot picks green snack packages from a store shelf and places them into a cardboard box on a shopping cart. Motions are smooth and deliberate, with accurate grasping and gentle release.
newview-048.zh: 双臂机器人从商店货架上拿取绿色包装的零食，放入购物车上的纸箱。动作平稳且有条不紊，抓取准确，放置轻柔。

newview-018.zh: 在箱子输送带场景中放置物体。

c2v-015.en: edge video condition. A robotic arm reaches for a yellow banana on a white table, grasps it, lifts it, and places it into a woven wicker basket positioned on the left side of the table.
c2v-015.zh: 以边缘视频为条件。机械臂伸向白色桌面上的黄色香蕉，将其抓起并提起，放入桌面左侧的柳编篮子中。

c2v-019.en: segmentation video condition. A robotic arm picks up a black marker from a white cloth-covered table and places it into a green panda-shaped pen holder. The motion is smooth and deliberate, with no interaction involving the nearby dark bottle.
c2v-019.zh: 以分割视频为条件。机械臂从铺着白布的桌面上拿起黑色记号笔，放入绿色熊猫造型的笔筒中。动作平稳且有条不紊，不接触附近的深色瓶子。

c2v-004.en: edge video condition. A dual-arm robot approaches a beige curtain and uses both grippers to untie the fabric tieback. It then pulls the curtain sideways to open it before releasing and retracting.
c2v-004.zh: 以边缘视频为条件。双臂机器人靠近米色窗帘，用两侧夹爪解开布质束带，再将窗帘向侧面拉开，随后松开夹爪并收回机械臂。

c2v-009.en: segmentation video condition. The robot arm moves toward a white coffee dispenser, grasps a black cup from the table, lifts it, positions it beneath the dispenser, and fills it with dark coffee before withdrawing it.
c2v-009.zh: 以分割视频为条件。机械臂移向白色咖啡机，从桌上抓起黑色杯子并提起，将杯子放到出液口下方，接满深色咖啡后移开。

c2v-005.en: depth video condition. A dual-arm robot operates in a room with wooden tables. The right arm grasps and rotates a black circular handle on a floor device while the left arm stays still.
c2v-005.zh: 以深度视频为条件。双臂机器人在摆有木桌的房间内操作。右臂抓住并转动地面设备上的黑色圆形把手，左臂保持不动。

c2v-013.en: depth video condition. The robot arm grasps a water bottle, lifts it smoothly, and pours water into an empty yellow plastic cup before returning the bottle to its original position. It then moves toward a black metal mug and picks up the now-filled yellow cup.
c2v-013.zh: 以深度视频为条件。机械臂抓住水瓶，平稳地提起，将水倒入空的黄色塑料杯，再把水瓶放回原位。随后，机械臂移向黑色金属马克杯，并拿起已装有水的黄色杯子。

v2c-008.zh: 预测边缘。打开微波炉门。

v2c-017.zh: 预测边缘。按颜色选取台球。

v2c-023.zh: 预测分割。按颜色选取积木。

v2c-004.zh: 预测深度。将工件合在一起。
